api:
<Mekko data={regions} segments={brands} name={|c: &Column| c.name} value={|c: &Column, i: usize| c.parts[i]} />
PropTypeDefault
dataone row per columnrequired
segmentsVec<SharedString>: the stacked parts, bottom firstrequired
nameFn(&T) -> &strrequired
valueFn(&T, usize) -> f64: the row's value for segment indexrequired
show_valuesbool: share of the column, written inside blocks that fittrue
gapf32: pixels between columns2.
legendLegendshown

Each column's width is its share of the grand total; its blocks split it by segment. Below each column: its name and its share of the total. The tooltip shows the value, the share of the column and the share of the total.

examples.title: Phone market
examples.description: Column width is each region's sales; heights split it by brand. Hover a block for its shares.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn market_share() {
    let data = use_signal(scaled(&[3.4, 4.1, 9.8, 1.6, 1.1]));
    rsx! { <Mekko data={data} segments={brands()} name={|c: &Column| c.name} value={|c: &Column, i: usize| c.parts[i]} class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Twelve months
examples.description: Many thin columns with a 1 px gap.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn many() {
    let data = use_signal(
        (0..12u64)
            .map(|month| Column {
                name: [
                    "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct",
                    "Nov", "Dec",
                ][month as usize],
                parts: (0..3)
                    .map(|part| 20. + noise(month * 10 + part) * 80.)
                    .collect(),
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    rsx! { <Mekko data={data} segments={names(&["Web", "App", "Store"])} name={|c: &Column| c.name} value={|c: &Column, i: usize| c.parts[i]} show_values={false} gap={1.} class="h-80" /> }
}
